author: ThioJoe
description:
Wasn't expecting the FBI to get hacked THIS BAD 🫪

The FBI recently got hacked, and it was a bad one. The hackers claim that they got not only the personal info of ALL FBI employees and applicants, but also 2-3 Terabytes of data from the FBI's AWS GovCloud storage. The government is apparently still trying to figure out exactly what was taken and are obviously investigating, but it's a developing situation. The hacker group has not asked for money, but instead have demanded the FBI remove a report which the group says has several specific false allegations. I talk about all that and more.
